history.summary: Workbench 0.12.0 keeps flow tracking and drafts in a local SQLite database (.mdse/workbench.db, sql.js); the base vault ignores .mdse/. New separate Testbench 0.1.0 plugin for test plans, runs and evidence capture (not bundled in the base vault yet) (D-0170).

Workbench 0.11.0 adds the Flow drop-down beside the work areas: eleven PLM flows (Change, New part, Redline, Issue, Review and approve, Options and alternates, Specify, Firmware, Document, Test plan, Test report) with Submitted sections, saved as records in _ops/Flows (D-0169, WKB-076, WKB-077).
Base vault adds Inkling 1.0.1 for drawing redlines (D-0167); Workbench 0.10.4 orders top canvas cards with the vendored d3-dag 2.0.0 when that gives fewer crossing lines (D-0168).
Paired toolset/Workbench update: canvas rows keep shared parts between their parents and unique parts toward their own parent (D-0166).
Context-only workflow projections; unrelated elements are introduced explicitly through vault Search and Canvas addition.
Paired toolset/Workbench source update for global search-to-active-Canvas addition.
Independent Importer version, visible toolset version, content fingerprint and CI version-bump enforcement.
Importer inherited the 0.10.0 toolset release and displayed a build hash; there was no separately maintained Importer version.
